description: Tavily URL content extraction. Fetches one or more URLs and returns clean, parsed text content (HTML/scripts/styles removed). Use when the user provides a URL or names a specific page to read.

tools.name: tavily_extract
tools.short_description: Fetch and extract clean text from one or more URLs - HTML stripped, scripts removed
tools.description: Fetch the content of one or more URLs and return clean extracted text. Up to 20 URLs per call. Use when the user gives you a URL, names a specific page ('read the README from anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python'), or when a previous tavily_search result is worth reading in detail. Returns raw_content per URL. Fails for JS-rendered SPAs (no JavaScript execution). For deep multi-page reading, prefer tavily_crawl. For discovering a site's pages, prefer tavily_map first.

urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from (1-20 URLs per call). Must be http or https.

include_images.description: Include images found on the pages in the response.

returns.description: Extraction results with raw_content per URL and a failed_results list for URLs that could not be fetched
